pi-durable moves from 035dc00 to 9586d85 (D-41 plus D-40 leftovers). New: the Pages layer (pages_* tools, on by default within the ceiling), person-approved runtime crons (off until crons.runtime.enable), the #/factory web route, the cron panel and a TUI harness view.
